summary: Tested the 3-output OnTheAir version and the macOS scripts. Backend: rewrote tests/test_ota.py for the ota_outputs schema; all 17 OTA/settings/OSC/WS tests pass. The 5 failures are all in TestVmix (backend_test.py): those older tests expect a vMix mock on 127.0.0.1, but vMix is set to 172.16.50.25 and offline as expected, so they are not regressions. Frontend: /ota shows the clock plus 3 stacked panels with the correct names, clip titles (9993/9994/9995.mov), ON AIR badges and countdowns that go down. Footer shows 'OnTheAir 3/3 connected'. Setting output 2 to port 9999 in /settings shows an 'Offline :9999' badge with --:--, the footer drops to 2/3 and outputs 1 and 3 are unaffected. Restoring 9994 reconnects in 0.2s. Renamed outputs show on /ota and persist after reload and in settings.json. An invalid host shows the red error message. uvicorn CPU stays around 0% while a port is unreachable. Regression: /, /vmix, the switcher tabs and the OSC settings work. bash -n passes for install-mac.sh and start-timer-mac.command, and both are executable (git mode 100755). Settings restored to defaults at the end.

ui_bugs.issue: The Idle badge has no data-testid, so ota-output-N-status is missing when an output is connected but idle

_load_settings migrates the legacy ota_port to output 1. This works, and the settings.json written now uses ota_outputs.
Duplicate ports across outputs are accepted without a warning (minor)

success_rate.backend: 100% of in-scope tests (17/17); 5 legacy vMix-mock tests fail as expected because vMix is offline

seed_data_creation: None. Temporary TEST_ names were set and then reverted to Output 1/2/3.

The TestVmix tests in backend_test.py need a vMix mock on 127.0.0.1 and vmix_host set to 127.0.0.1. Defaults are restored at the end of test_ota.py.
